svg.title: What runs in production
svg.desc: LANGUAGES five I ship with: TypeScript, JavaScript, Elixir, Python, Rust. INTERFACES that feel fast: Next.js, React, Astro, SvelteKit, React Router, Tailwind, HeroUI, Motion, GSAP, Three.js, Vite, TanStack Query, Zustand, D3, Lenis. BACKENDS that hold up: Node.js, NestJS, Hono, Express, Phoenix, Ash, Oban, FastAPI, Axum, Tokio, GraphQL, Apollo, Zod, Stripe, Better Auth, Clerk. DATA that stays put: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Neon, Prisma, Drizzle, Redis, S3 / R2. APPLIED AI that works on its own: Claude, MCP, Replicate, LiveKit, WhatsApp, Resend, Langfuse, ONNX, OpenCV. SHIPPING without scares: Vercel, Cloudflare, Workers, Railway, Docker, Turborepo, pnpm, GitHub Actions, Woodpecker CI, Nginx, Caddy, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, PostHog. QUALITY checked before it ships: Vitest, Playwright, Testing Library, Biome, ESLint.
